title: Run the upload hub overnight
purpose: Every phone that comes in tonight is counted, uploaded, charged, and back at its site before 7:00 AM.
with: the runner, who counts and signs with you
when: Every night, from the first bag to the morning check-out. Two hubs: Central, the Central Cairo warehouse and office, and East, in 5th Settlement. Thursday night is the full flush.

steps.do: Get the room ready before the first bag
steps.detail: Every cable free, the router on, the dashboard open, the log at tonight's date.
steps.check: One free cable per phone expected tonight.

steps.do: Check in each bag: count it against its phone list and sign
steps.detail: Count by device number. Both of you sign the list and write the time in. Any number that does not match: call the Planning and Logistics Lead now.
steps.check: Every list signed by two people.

steps.do: Dock every phone and start the upload
steps.detail: One phone per cable. Watch the dashboard until every phone shows uploading.
steps.check: Every phone shows uploading on the dashboard.

steps.detail: A phone that stopped: unplug it, plug it in again. Still stuck: note the device number in the log.
steps.check: No phone stuck for more than an hour.

steps.detail: Every run due tonight is in, or the Planning and Logistics Lead knows which one is not.
steps.check: The log shows a time in for every run on the plan.

steps.do: Check every phone has room for a full day before it leaves
steps.detail: Check the dashboard. A few videos still waiting is fine. A phone that is still nearly full stays, and its Portfolio Manager hears before 7:00 AM.
steps.check: Every phone that leaves has room for a full day.

steps.do: Check out each bag: repack by site, count it with the runner, and sign
steps.who: With the same runner as last night
steps.time: Early morning, in time for 7:00 AM
steps.detail: One bag per site, a new phone list in each. The same runner takes the same three sites as last night. Count by device number. Both of you sign the list and write the time out.
steps.check: Every bag has a list signed by two people, and every phone is back at its site before 7:00 AM.

steps.do: Send the night's numbers, then lock up
steps.detail: To the Planning and Logistics Lead: phones in, phones out, phones held and why.
steps.check: The Planning and Logistics Lead has the three numbers.

done: Every phone is back at its site empty and charged, or held with its Portfolio Manager told.

fails.if: The count and the phone list do not match
fails.then: Recount by device number. Sign for what you counted. Call the Planning and Logistics Lead now.
Hold it. It leaves empty or not at all. Tell its Portfolio Manager tonight.

fails.if: Many uploads stop, or the line goes down
fails.then: Restart the router once. Still down: call the Planning and Logistics Lead now, who sends the runs to the other hub.

fails.if: The runner comes and phones are still uploading
fails.then: Hold them. Two nights in a row means the hub is over capacity: tell the Planning and Logistics Lead.

fails.if: A run comes from the west side or 6th of October
fails.then: It comes to Central. There is no West hub yet.

escalate: The line, the hub, a run, a runner, or a count: the Planning and Logistics Lead, now. A missing phone: Moharam within the hour.
